_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/counters/test_nth_counter_placed.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_ncp_rings is Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings on a {G} 1/1: a +1/+1 counter for every card you draw, and draw five and gain 5 when the tenth +1/+1 counter is put on it. t_ncp_charge watches the third charge counter, so the kind is pinned by a second card. The bolt comes from testing.cards.json.
